description: This Java source file defines the AlarmAdapter class for managing and displaying alarm items within a RecyclerView in an Android application. It handles binding alarm data to views, managing alarm list operations, and drawing item dividers.

classes.name: AlarmAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding alarm data to RecyclerView items, managing alarm list operations, and handling user interactions such as deleting alarms.

classes.name: AlarmViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to alarm item views within the RecyclerView.

classes.name: SortedListCallback
classes.description: Callback class for managing sorted list operations of Alarm objects.

classes.name: DividerItemDecoration
classes.description: RecyclerView.ItemDecoration subclass that draws dividers between alarm items.

methods.name: AlarmAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the alarm list, storage, and formatting tools.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AlarmViewHolder for a RecyclerView item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds alarm data to the ViewHolder and sets up delete button behavior.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of alarms.

methods.name: addAlarm
methods.description: Adds a new alarm to the list and refreshes the view.

methods.name: deleteAlarm
methods.description: Removes an alarm from the list and refreshes the view.

methods.name: AlarmViewHolder
methods.description: Holds references to views within an alarm item layout.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Alarm objects for sorting.

methods.name: onInserted
methods.description: Callback for item insertion in sorted list (no operation).

methods.name: onRemoved
methods.description: Callback for item removal in sorted list (no operation).

methods.name: onMoved
methods.description: Callback for item move in sorted list (no operation).

methods.name: onChanged
methods.description: Callback for item change in sorted list (no operation).

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two Alarm objects have the same content.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two Alarm objects are the same item.
